verdict: No paid activity running; organic reach is the only source and it's fading.
narrative: Paid advertising has been off for the full 28-day window — zero spend on Meta and Google — so your Google Business Profile has been the sole channel driving any inbound activity. That profile delivered 97 actions this period (21 calls, 30 direction requests, 46 website clicks), but actions dropped 22% week-over-week and went flat at zero for the last three days, signaling a real and confirmed short-term decline in local visibility. Instagram reach fell 29% week-over-week in the same stretch, so organic momentum across channels is softening together. Restarting paid campaigns is the direct fix; without that inflow, the pipeline has no new opportunities entering it.
